material.description: CDC/NIOSH, “Electrical Safety in the Workplace”, “Key points”, “Qualified vs. unqualified persons” and “Recommendations”. The source limits electrical work to qualified persons; work on energized equipment requires qualification and appropriate PPE; it also calls for energy-control procedures and verification of de-energization. This supports the qualification, procedure and protective-equipment boundary. It is not permission to perform live work and does not replace applicable electrical codes or site-specific procedures.
